trello.name: the Android crash
trello.desc: Yeah, that's the photo upload crash on Android 14. Crash reports show a NullPointerException in the media picker callback when the user backgrounds the app mid-upload. It's our top crasher right now, about 4% of Android sessions. Repro is: start a photo upload, background the app before it finishes, come back. I can take it. Please do, and I'd like it fixed and verified by Wednesday so QA has time before the release. Sam, can you confirm the fix on the Android 14 test devices once Marcus lands it? Yep, I'll add it to the regression run.

trello.name: offline mode for the notes list
trello.desc: Next, offline mode for the notes list. We promised this to the enterprise customers last quarter. The backend side is a sync API: the client sends its last-synced timestamp and gets a delta of created, updated, and deleted notes. I'll build that endpoint this sprint. Conflict resolution is last-write-wins for now; we agreed we're not doing merge UI in this pass. And I'll do the client side: local cache in Room, queue writes while offline, replay them when connectivity comes back. Acceptance criteria as I understand it: you can open the app in airplane mode, see your notes, edit them, and everything reconciles when you're back online with no data loss. That's exactly the bar. Write that into the ticket, please. Also Elena is out the 17th and 18th, so plan reviews around that. I'll have the sync API in review before I'm out.

trello.name: CI
trello.desc: Third item: CI. Jenkins fell over twice last week and nobody knows how to fix the plugin soup anymore. I want to migrate our pipelines to GitHub Actions. I've already got a proof of concept for the build job. This sprint I'd finish the test and release pipelines, keep the nightly build schedule, and run both systems in parallel for a week before we turn Jenkins off. Approved, but keep Jenkins alive until the parallel week is clean.

trello.name: the search thing from the incident review
trello.desc: Elena, there was also the search thing from the incident review? Right. The search endpoint got hammered by a misbehaving script last week and degraded for everyone. I'm going to add per-user rate limiting: 100 requests per minute per user, return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header beyond that. It also needs a metrics counter so we can see who's hitting the limit.

trello.name: consent screen GDPR compliance
trello.desc: One more compliance item: legal flagged that our consent screen doesn't meet GDPR requirements for the EU launch. Marcus, we need the privacy policy screen updated so consent is opt-in with separate toggles for analytics and marketing, not a single pre-checked box. That has to be in the August 20 release, it's a launch blocker. Understood. I'll get the new copy from legal and rebuild the screen. Opt-in toggles, nothing pre-checked.

trello.name: payments flow automated coverage
trello.desc: Last one. Sam, the payments flow still has no automated coverage and it burned us in the last release. I'll write regression tests for the payments flow: purchase, restore, cancellation, and the receipt validation path. Goal is to have them running in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline.
